title: Apricot and Blueberry Free-Form Tart
changes_from_base: Apricots and blueberries baked in a folded free-form crust rather than a blind-baked case with crème pâtissière.
summary: A crisp, sugared free-form crust wrapped round tangy apricots and sweet blueberries.

ingredients.item: plain flour, plus a little for the worktop
fine sea salt or table salt
very cold water, plus 1 tbsp for the edge
apricots, stoned and cut into 1 cm wedges

steps.title: Grate
steps.text: mix the flour and salt in the bowl. Grate the frozen butter straight in on the coarse side and toss with a fork so every shred is coated. Work fast so the butter stays frozen.

steps.title: Mix
steps.text: add 90 ml cold water and stir with the fork, then squeeze the dough together with your hands; add drops more water only if it crumbles. Flatten into a disc, wrap and chill for an hour.

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: heat the oven to 190 °C (170 °C fan) and line the tray. Let the dough stand 10 min, roll it on a lightly floured surface to a 30 cm circle and move it to the tray.

steps.title: Fill
steps.text: combine the apricots and blueberries with 60 g of the sugar and spread them over the middle, stopping 5 cm short of the edge.

steps.title: Enclose
steps.text: turn the pastry edge up and over the fruit, letting it fold on itself in pleats, and press the pleats together gently.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: paint the pastry with 1 tbsp water, scatter on the final 15 g sugar and bake 45-50 min, until the crust is richly browned and the apricots are soft and bubbling.

steps.title: Serve
steps.text: cool 10 min on the tray, free the base with the palette knife, then rest on the rack about 30 min and serve warm. A little juice may leak; it caramelises on the paper and is fine.

tips: Ripe apricots should give a little when pressed but not feel soft.
Tinned apricots are too wet here; use fresh fruit.
A spoon of ground almonds under the fruit soaks up extra juice, but adds nuts.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Best eaten the day it is baked. Cover leftovers and keep at room temperature overnight.
